summary: Appeal against acquittal for suicide abetment; Sections 306 498A read with 34 IPC; FIR by deceased father who died before testimony; presumption under Evidence Act S.113A requires cogent evidence of cruelty/harassment; insufficient evidence to establish abetment; mere property dispute insufficient for suicide causation; hyper sensitivity may explain suicide; FIR admissibility through IO if informant deceased; no error in HC reappreciation; appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court acquittal upheld; no evidence of abetment to sustain conviction.
